what: On the loader panel, thousands of accent- and text-colored dots float upward (.55) and gather into an eye shape — 62% go to the outer ellipse (22% of screen width·max 260px, .42× tall, bulging toward the sides), the rest to a ring around the center pupil, with the pull growing by .945 each frame over 1.15. Once everything has gathered, the top and bottom eyelid panels close in .12s, then rise .16 later over .85s with power3.inOut, and meanwhile a light circle spreads from the center from .08 to 1.5× in .55s and goes out in .7s as the whole panel disappears in .7s. All at 1.65× speed (about 2.2s overall)

options.speed: Speed multiplier, default 1.65 — opens 2 sides faster
options.drift: Floating duration (s before speed scaling), default .55
options.gather: Gathering duration (s before speed multiplier), default 1.15
options.count: Dot count, default 2200 on wide screens · 900 on phones
options.[data-fx-part=canvas]: Canvas to draw dots on (created if missing)
options.[data-fx-part=lid-top]·[data-fx-part=lid: Two eyelids and a light circle (created if missing)
options.fx:reveal·fx:done: Event fired at the moment of blinking (when the Hero starts) · when everything has vanished
